name: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease axonal type 2N
description: Autosomal dominant Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2N (CMT2N) is a mild form of axonal Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease, a peripheral sensorimotor neuropathy, characterized by distal legs sensory loss and weakness that can be asymmetric. Tendon reflexes are reduced in the knees and absent in ankles. Progression is slow.
